Rollen har många kontaktytor och innebär samarbete med bland annat projektledning, produktion, kund, underentreprenörer, leverantörer och övriga funktioner i projektorganisationen. Dina huvudsakliga arbetsuppgifter omfattar: Stödja projektledningen i kostnadsstyrning och ekonomisk uppföljning Följa upp projektets kostnader, prognoser, KPI och enhetstider samt analysera avvikelser Etablera och följa upp mängdhantering i mängdreglerade entreprenader och underentreprenader Administrera och följa upp ÄTA-arbeten gentemot kund, underentreprenörer och leverantörer Identifiera, dokumentera och rapportera avvikelser samt bidra till korrigerande åtgärder Kontrollera leverantörsfakturor och kontera mot projektets resurskontoplan Bevaka och inhämta dokumentation från underentreprenörer och leverantörer enligt avtal och projektkrav Bistå med kvalitets-, miljö- och arbetsmiljödokumentation samt riskbedömningar Bidra till rapportering och slutdokumentation till kund vid behov Identifiera och driva förbättringar av projektets arbetssätt och processer En viktig del av rollen är att bidra till ett välfungerande projektteam där vi delar kunskap, hjälper varandra och tillsammans löser de utmaningar som uppstår. Du förväntas ta ansvar för dina egna områden, men också bidra till projektets helhet och framdrift. Din profil som Projektingenjör inriktning stål Vi söker dig som har kandidatexamen, civilingenjörsexamen eller annan relevant eftergymnasial utbildning och några års arbetslivserfarenhet från bygg-, anläggnings- eller industriverksamhet. För att lyckas i rollen ser vi gärna att du har: Praktisk erfarenhet av ekonomirelaterat arbete inom projektverksamhet Förståelse för entreprenadadministration och ÄTA-hantering God förståelse för byggprocessen och de parametrar som påverkar projektets ekonomi och genomförande Förmåga att strukturera och följa upp information från underentreprenörer och leverantörer Goda kunskaper i svenska och engelska, både muntligt och skriftligt Det är meriterande om du har erfarenhet av större industriella investeringsprojekt, entreprenadverksamhet eller komplexa byggprojekt. Som person är du strukturerad, analytisk och affärsmässig. Du har lätt för att skapa förtroende och goda relationer och trivs med att samarbeta över funktioner och kompetensområden. Du är kommunikativ, prestigelös och lösningsorienterad och delar gärna med dig av din kunskap. Du tar ansvar, är nyfiken och har förmågan att både se detaljerna i dina egna arbetsuppgifter och förstå hur de bidrar till projektets helhet. För oss är det viktigt att lyckas tillsammans . Därför söker vi dig som vill vara en del av ett team där vi stöttar varandra, löser problem tillsammans och skapar resultat som en gemensam prestation. Om NCC Green Industry Transformation NCC Green Industry Transformation är ett nystartat affärsområde som arbetar med stora och komplexa projekt inom framtidens gröna industri. NCC och SSAB har tecknat avtal för bygg- och anläggningsarbetena för den östra halvan av ett nytt stålverk på Svartön i Luleå – ett nyckelprojekt i omställningen till fossilfri stålproduktion. Stålverket beräknas vara i drift 2029. Nytt stålverk i Luleå | NCC Ytterligare information Rollen kräver 100% fysisk närvaro på vårt projekt i Luleå, en förutsättning för att lyckas med rollen. Det är dock möjligt att ta sig an denna roll även för den som bor på annan ort. NCC ombesörjer resor och boende och 100% fysisk närvaro kan vara måndag-torsdag alternativt tisdag-fredag. För denna tjänst genomför vi bakgrundskontroll enligt NCC:s säkerhetskultur. review_candidates.title: Project Management Office Opportunities (Multi-Disciplinary)
review_candidates.description: At HKA, you’ll work with project owners, contractors and infrastructure investors across asset-heavy industries including Energy, Water, Transport, Resources and Data Centres, delivering complex programs reliably, on time and on budget. We support clients across the capital lifecycle, from setting major programs up for success, through commercial advisory and supply chain engagement, to delivery assurance during execution. You’ll contribute across this spectrum, combining strategic advice, capability building and hands-on support. What sets HKA apart is where we’ve come from. We’re globally recognised for claims and dispute resolution when projects don’t go to plan. That experience shapes how we work day to day, grounded in what actually happens on projects. You’ll be part of a team helping clients make better decisions, deliver more reliably and avoid costly missteps. At HKA, you’ll work alongside experienced practitioners on real project challenges, with early responsibility and tangible impact As Part Of The HKA Team You Can Expect A unique opportunity to influence a major infrastructure program through planning, governance, risk, and project controls. Exposure to complex, large-scale projects and senior decision-makers across the project lifecycle. The chance to contribute to a program that will deliver lasting benefits for the Sunshine Coast community. The Opportunity Our Project Management Office (PMO) team is preparing to support a landmark infrastructure program on the Sunshine Coast, creating a rare opportunity for experienced project controls and PMO professionals to join a major program in its formative stages. This high-profile, multi-disciplinary infrastructure program will help shape the future of one of Australia's fastest-growing regions. We're seeking experienced professionals who thrive in complex project environments and can provide the insights, governance, and controls that underpin successful project delivery. We're currently seeking talented professionals across several PMO disciplines, including: Cost Managers Planners and Schedulers Risk Managers Governance, Assurance & Reporting Managers Project Controls Managers Change Control Managers Document Controllers As part of the PMO team, you'll play a critical role in providing the forecasting, planning, risk management, reporting, and governance frameworks that enable effective decision-making across the program. Working closely with project leadership, delivery teams, and key stakeholders, you'll help drive performance, manage complexity, and support successful project outcomes. Joining the program at this stage offers a unique opportunity to influence how major projects are planned, governed, and delivered. You'll work alongside industry-leading professionals on a program of significant scale and complexity while contributing to an enduring legacy for the Sunshine Coast. Whether you're looking to apply your expertise on a career-defining infrastructure program or seeking an opportunity to make a strategic impact within a high-performing PMO environment, this is a rare chance to be part of something significant. Skills And Experience To be successful in this opportunity, you will bring a combination of project controls expertise, strategic thinking, and the ability to influence outcomes within complex infrastructure environments. Ideally, You Will Possess The Following Demonstrated experience (typically 10+ years) within project controls, PMO, or project delivery functions on major infrastructure, transport, civil, utilities, or capital works programs. Strong stakeholder engagement and relationship management skills, with the ability to influence decision-making across project teams, clients, delivery partners, and executive stakeholders. Proven experience working within complex, multidisciplinary project environments, collaborating across multiple workstreams, interfaces, and delivery functions. Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to present complex information clearly and provide meaningful insights to senior stakeholders. Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities, with experience translating project data into actionable recommendations and business outcomes. Experience managing competing priorities within large-scale, fast-paced project environments while maintaining a focus on delivery objectives. A continuous improvement mindset, with a commitment to strengthening governance, controls, reporting, and best-practice project delivery frameworks. Advanced proficiency in project controls, reporting, forecasting, risk management, scheduling, governance, or cost management disciplines relevant to your area of expertise. Flexibility and willingness to travel across the Sunshine Coast region as required to support project delivery. Desirable Experience Candidates with any of the following experience will be highly regarded: Experience working within major infrastructure, transport, roads, rail, utilities, or capital works programs. Previous involvement in client-side, contractor, consultancy, alliance, or integrated delivery environments. Knowledge of alliance contracting principles and collaborative project delivery models. Experience supporting program governance, assurance, reporting, portfolio management, or project controls functions within complex project environments. Experience working with local government, state government, or other major infrastructure stakeholders. Involvement in establishing or enhancing PMO frameworks, project controls systems, reporting processes, or governance structures on large-scale programs. We operate a flexible working pattern both in terms of hours and location and are happy with flexible remote working. review_candidates.description: Join CNI and Build Your Career with Us 1.    ABOUT CNI: CN CO., LTD. (CNI) is a leading manufacturing and construction company in Southeast Asia, focusing on onshore and offshore static equipment. We specialize in Pressure Vessels, including Process Vessels and Storage Tanks, Electromechanical Systems, and oversized Steel Structures.   We provide a full range of services complying with international standards and customize every project to meet clients’ specific requirements.   With nearly three decades of experience and expertise, CNI has brought reliable solutions to our customers from a wide range of industries, including Oil & Gas, Energy, Chemical, Steel Fabrication, Thermal Power Plant, etc.   As part of our factory expansion and business growth, CNI is currently looking for qualified and motivated candidates to join our team as: PROJECT ENGINEER The Project Engineer will work closely with the Project Management team and relevant departments to coordinate and monitor project execution, ensuring that project activities are carried out in accordance with schedule, quality, technical, and contractual requirements. 2. THE JOB'S MAIN PURPOSE Responsible for carrying out assigned project management activities and coordinating with relevant departments to monitor and control project execution in accordance with Manual requirements, applicable codes and standards, company regulations, contractual requirements, and specific assignments from the Project Management Manager. The Project Engineer will support the PM/PMM/PMDM in project planning, progress monitoring, documentation control, coordination, and issue follow-up throughout project execution. 3. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES Receive assigned projects from the Project Management Manager and carry out assigned project management activities. In liaison with client and DE, QCI, QCM, WSM, Procurement department to control project progress, Project documentation. Prepare, update, monitor, and expedite the project schedule and progress by using information provided by the Design Engineer, Purchasing, Production Engineer, Site Manager, Work Shop Manager, and report to the PM/PMM/PMDM. Overseeing all incoming and outgoing project documentation. In liaison with client, assigned personnel of project and Design & Proposal, Procurement, Workshop and Quality department for execute project to complete project satisfy with delivery time and quality requirements. ·      Other scope of work as specified by the Project Management Manager. ·      Assist in controlling procurement and fabrication within the project budget and contract limits. Periodically report on project progress and risks (if any) to the Deputy Manager/Manager/Board of Directors. 4. CAPABILITY STANDARDS & OTHER REQUIREMENTS General Requirements: Education: Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Engineering, Project Management. English: Good command of English, particularly in technical communication, email correspondence, and project documentation. Experience: minimum of 1 year in an equivalent position. Knowledge: Knowledge of pressure equipment, HRSG, fabrication processes, and relevant technical requirements for project execution. Skills: Project planning, scheduling, monitoring, and coordination. Good skills in Microsoft Office, AutoCAD, Microsoft Project, and/or Primavera P6. Project documentation and reporting. Communication and coordination with internal and external stakeholders. Abilities: Ability to develop, update, monitor, and follow up on project schedules. Ability to effectively communicate and coordinate with internal departments, clients, suppliers, and other stakeholders. Ability to identify and follow up on project issues, delays, and risks. Previous experience working with multi-brand portfolios and familiarity with the Indonesian advertising landscape is an advantage.
